استغلظ : see 1, in three places. ＝
-A2- استغلظهُ He saw it to be, regarded it as, or esteemed it, thick, gross, big, bulky, or coarse. (Msb.) He abstained from purchasing it (namely a garment, or piece of cloth, S) because of its thickness, or coarseness. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
